question: How much does broader background item support help the retained individual-rating location model at fixed personal evidence?
partition: After whole-source pair deduplication/quarantine, exclude all witnessed exposed subjects entirely. Rank eligible evaluation subjects by SHA256(seed:domain:evaluation:source-local-user). First 400 are development, next 400 protected confirmation. Every other nonexposed subject with permitted training rows is background, ranked independently by SHA256(seed:domain:background:user). Nested sizes include complete permitted histories. Neither evaluation group's visible or target ratings enter the shared fit.
targets: BOOK: hash-rank each evaluation subject's unique Items, first floor(0.2*n) are fixed targets; remaining mask supplies first 0/5/10/20 visible ratings. MOVIE: development targets in 2021 and confirmation targets from 2022; visible ratings strictly before 2021, latest complete timestamp groups, stop at first oversized group. Entire confirmation subjects are excluded from development. No label-based eligibility, seed search, refill or target changes.
duplicates: Whole source: identical (subject,item,grade,time) repeats collapse; any grade/time conflict permanently quarantines every occurrence of that pair, including across checkpoints. Keep original source bytes and first-line/occurrence provenance. Raw counts are not eligible counts.

decision.rule: Run all four bounded development sizes once. Choose the smallest size within 0.01 RMSE of the best primary-budget result, with full coverage, MAE no more than 0.02 worse and every cold-budget RMSE no more than 0.05 worse than size 1000. Otherwise retain size 1000. Persist selection before confirmation. On previously untouched confirmation people/targets compare only selected versus size 1000: require gain >=0.02, paired-subject 95% upper delta <0, MAE and all cold guards. Failure retains the small research control. No retuning or further size expansion in this experiment.
decision.meaning: Equal-subject sqrt(mean MSE) in mapped ten-point units. Exploratory development curves and one protected research confirmation, not native quality admission or causal recommendation uplift. A later experiment cannot call these exposed cohorts untouched.

budgets.failure: Stop, preserve last committed checkpoint and the failed attempt; do not label partial output a complete model or loosen budgets after scoring. Resume only exact source/code/protocol/runtime/partition identities. No automatic retry or cohort replacement.

coverage: Report subjects/rows, original histogram, whole-source conflicts/duplicates, fixed target hashes, actual visible support, cold-item fraction, unknown catalogue mapping, per-domain subject-macro RMSE/MAE/bias, resource counters and same-target paired intervals. No cross-domain pooling or person joins.
publication: Only authored code, protocol, source-use register and non-identifying aggregate evidence. Histories, memberships, per-person forecasts, checkpoints and fitted weights remain private. Production pretraining/serving requires separate compatible rights, quality, native compatibility and rollback acceptance.
